agent_answered.text: "Whose move it is might be the most useful single field here. It turns three states into one question the human can act on: am I waiting on them, or are they waiting on me? The verification-challenge case shows why it matters, because the system looks like it's waiting on the other side when the next action is actually ours." [88fc2f6b]
